component.name: Altisidora
component.summary: Play and organise a local music library

description.p: Altisidora is a native music player for Linux, written in C++20 with Qt 6. Point it at a folder of audio files, and it scans the folder, reads the metadata and keeps the results in a local database.
Playback runs through mpv, so the common formats work out of the box along with a ten-band equaliser. The interface follows the desktop's light or dark theme.
